svg.title: HealthCoach critical user journey, full
svg.desc: End-to-end patient journey through the HealthCoach chatbot, from onboarding and orientation through pre-note approval and handoff to the broader evaluation. Five phases with stage-gate transitions.
svg.text: Cross-cutting: single scrolling window · fixed top nav with progress bar
